name: default
command:
ulimit -c 0
cd /data/local/tmp/dense-af-dvfs
env LD_LIBRARY_PATH=. ADSP_LIBRARY_PATH=. GGML_HEXAGON_DEVICES=1 GGML_HEXAGON_PROFILE=0 timeout 30 taskset c0 ./dense-af-bench -m /data/local/tmp/models/Qwen2.5-3B-2K/ggml/weights.gguf --device HTP0 --prompt 1 --past 256 --layers 17 --stage both --flash 1 --threads 2 --warmup 1 --reps 2 --reference reference
